title: Sell Mineral Rights in Miltonsburg, OH
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Miltonsburg, OH | Monroe County
metaDescription: Miltonsburg sits in Monroe County's Utica core, among Ohio's most active drilling territory. See what that means for a mineral rights sale here.
heroLead: Miltonsburg is a small unincorporated community in Monroe County, sitting inside one of the most consistently productive parts of Ohio's Utica/Point Pleasant core.
intro: Monroe County has quietly become one of the strongest Utica counties in the state, with dry gas wells that rank among the highest-producing horizontal shale wells anywhere in Ohio. If your family owns mineral rights near Miltonsburg, there's a real chance you're sitting on or near acreage that's already been leased and drilled, and the paperwork trail matters more here than the initial phone call.

sections.heading: Monroe County's dry gas wells and why they matter
paragraphs: Unlike the wetter, liquids-rich gas produced in some neighboring counties, much of Monroe County's Utica production is dry gas, and operators including Ascent Resources and Antero Resources have drilled some of the highest-volume wells in the entire play here. If a well near Miltonsburg is in that category, the royalty income on even a small fractional interest can be meaningfully higher than similar acreage elsewhere.

sections.heading: Checking your unit participation near Miltonsburg
paragraphs: Given the county's strength, it's worth confirming precisely which unit, if any, your parcel is included in, and what your decimal interest is per the division order. Two neighboring tracts can have very different value if one is inside a top-performing unit and the other sits just outside it.

sections.heading: Woodsfield records and the Ohio Dormant Mineral Act
paragraphs: The Monroe County Recorder's office in Woodsfield, the county seat, holds lease and unit records for Miltonsburg-area land. Because Monroe County has such a long, active leasing history, it's also worth checking for any dormant mineral notices filed against older, unused interests, since Ohio's use-it-or-lose-it statute has been actively applied in this part of the state.

faqs.question: Why is Monroe County considered especially strong for Utica gas?
faqs.answer: It has produced some of the highest-volume dry gas horizontal wells in the entire Utica/Point Pleasant play, with heavy activity from operators like Ascent Resources and Antero Resources.

faqs.question: Does dry gas production pay differently than wet gas?
faqs.answer: Yes, the pricing and volume dynamics differ. Dry gas wells are valued primarily on gas volume and price, while wet gas wells also capture value from natural gas liquids. Your royalty statement will reflect which category your well falls into.

faqs.question: Where do I check unit and lease records near Miltonsburg?
faqs.answer: The Monroe County Recorder's office in Woodsfield holds these records for the entire county, including small communities like Miltonsburg.

faqs.question: Has the Ohio Dormant Mineral Act been used actively in Monroe County?
faqs.answer: Given the county's long and active leasing history, dormant mineral filings do appear here. It's worth checking whether any notice has been filed against an older, unused interest in your family's name.
